package main

// EncodeVoteV4 (pkg/intentcert govroot_v4.go): the canonical length-prefixed encoding of one vote record that govRoot v4 commits, over the
// votes of the fixture, the real document, and typed mutations of them.

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"math/rand"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"

	"github.com/certen/independant-validator/pkg/intentcert"
	proofv2 "github.com/certen/independant-validator/pkg/proof/v2"
)

type VoteEnc struct {
	Hex string `json:"hex,omitempty"`
	Err string `json:"err,omitempty"`
}

func encodeVote(v *proofv2.Vote) (out VoteEnc, ok bool) {
	defer func() {
		if r := recover(); r != nil {
			lastPanic = fmt.Sprintf("%v | %s", r, topFrames(stackNow(), 6))
			ok = false
		}
	}()
	b, err := intentcert.EncodeVoteV4(v)
	if err != nil {
		return VoteEnc{Err: err.Error()}, true
	}
	return VoteEnc{Hex: hex.EncodeToString(b)}, true
}

type VoteMutation struct {
	ID      string  `json:"id"`
	Base    int     `json:"base"`
	Op      string  `json:"op"`
	Patches []Patch `json:"patches"`
	Expect  VoteEnc `json:"expect"`
}

type VoteFile struct {
	Format     string         `json:"format"`
	Bases      []any          `json:"bases"`
	BaseNames  []string       `json:"baseNames"`
	BaseExpect []VoteEnc      `json:"baseExpect"`
	Mutations  []VoteMutation `json:"mutations"`
	NoVerdict  int            `json:"noVerdict"`
}

func votesCorpus(validator, out string, per int) error {
	f := &VoteFile{Format: "certen-sdk/s3-votes-corpus/v1"}
	add := func(name string, v proofv2.Vote) error {
		var tree any
		if err := json.Unmarshal(mustJSON(v), &tree); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		f.Bases = append(f.Bases, tree)
		f.BaseNames = append(f.BaseNames, name)
		e, ok := encodeVote(&v)
		if !ok || e.Err != "" {
			return fmt.Errorf("base %s: %+v", name, e)
		}
		f.BaseExpect = append(f.BaseExpect, e)
		return nil
	}
	if err := add("fixture", x21Vote()); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	inline := x21Vote()
	inline.Transport = proofv2.VoteTransport{Kind: proofv2.TransportInline}
	inline.Cause = ""
	inline.Hops, inline.Counted = nil, nil
	inline.Produced = &proofv2.Production{Account: xPrincipal, Chain: "signature", Message: hx32(10), Receipt: "1011", Arrival: proofv2.Arrival{At: proofv2.IndexProof{Position: 3, Entry: hx32(30), Receipt: "00"}}}
	if err := add("inline", inline); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := add("empty", proofv2.Vote{}); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	r, err := loadReal21(validator)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	for i, v := range r.ev.Votes {
		if err := add(fmt.Sprintf("real-%d", i), v); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	for bi, base := range f.Bases {
		var nodes []node
		collect(base, nil, &nodes)
		var usable []node
		for _, n := range nodes {
			if len(n.path) > 0 {
				usable = append(usable, n)
			}
		}
		for k := 0; k < per; k++ {
			rr := rand.New(rand.NewSource(seedOf("votes", f.BaseNames[bi], fmt.Sprint(k))))
			count := 1
			if rr.Intn(4) == 0 {
				count = 2
			}
			var ps []Patch
			var ops []string
			for c := 0; c < count; c++ {
				t := usable[rr.Intn(len(usable))]
				for tries := 0; tries < 4; tries++ {
					switch t.v.(type) {
					case map[string]any, []any:
						if rr.Intn(3) != 0 {
							t = usable[rr.Intn(len(usable))]
							continue
						}
					}
					break
				}
				p, name := mutate(rr, t, "")
				if p.Op == "rename" {
					continue
				}
				ps = append(ps, p)
				ops = append(ops, name+"@"+pathString(p.Path))
			}
			if len(ps) == 0 {
				continue
			}
			mutated, ok := applyPatches(base, ps)
			if !ok {
				continue
			}
			raw, err := json.Marshal(mutated)
			if err != nil {
				continue
			}
			var v proofv2.Vote
			d := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(raw))
			d.DisallowUnknownFields()
			if err := d.Decode(&v); err != nil {
				f.NoVerdict++
				continue
			}
			lastPanic = ""
			e, ok := encodeVote(&v)
			if !ok {
				if lastPanic != "" {
					fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "PANIC votes/%s#%02d [%s]: %s\n", f.BaseNames[bi], k, strings.Join(ops, " + "), lastPanic)
				}
				continue
			}
			f.Mutations = append(f.Mutations, VoteMutation{ID: fmt.Sprintf("votes/%s#%02d", f.BaseNames[bi], k), Base: bi, Op: strings.Join(ops, " + "), Patches: ps, Expect: e})
		}
	}
	return writeGz(filepath.Join(out, "votes-cases.json.gz"), mustJSON(f))
}
